test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pinki and Rinki together can do a piece of work in 20 days. Rinki and Minki together can do it in 12 days while Pinki and Minki together can do it in 15 days. In how long can Rinki alone do it?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(20, 12, 15) = 60 units.

Efficiency: (Pinki+Rinki) = 3, (Rinki+Minki) = 5, (Pinki+Minki) = 4.

2 × (Pinki+Rinki+Minki) efficiency = 3 + 5 + 4 = 12 ⇒ P+R+M = 6 units/day.

Rinki efficiency = (P+R+M) − (Pinki+Minki) = 6 − 4 = 2 units/day.

Time for Rinki = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (Pinki + Rinki) = 20 days

Time taken by (Rinki + Minki) = 12 days

Time taken by (Pinki + Minki) = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time Taken

Combined efficiency of 2 × (Pinki + Rinki + Minki) = 3 + 5 + 4 = 12 units/day

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of (Pinki + Rinki + Minki) = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Rinki = Efficiency of (Pinki + Rinki + Minki) − Efficiency of (Pinki + Minki)

⇒ Efficiency of Rinki = 6 − 4 = 2 units/day

⇒ Time taken by Rinki alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Rinki

⇒ Time taken by Rinki alone = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days

**∴ The correct answer is 30 day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. If a person takes T days to complete work, their efficiency is 1/T units per day.

Combined Work Formula

When pairs are given, the total efficiency 2 × (A+B+C) = Eff(A+B) + Eff(B+C) + Eff(C+A). Individual efficiency is found by subtracting the pair that does not include the target person.

Work and Wages

In any piece of work, wages are always distributed in the ratio of the amount of work done by each individual, which depends on their efficiency and time spent working.
